name: Beach Ball Reversal (Negative GEX Pit)
setup: Price drops into a major negative GEX (purple) node cluster — a 'pit' of negative gamma. As puts go ITM, gamblers cash out, forcing dealers to buy back short hedges. This creates a 'trampoline effect' that launches price back up (the 'Beach Ball').
entry: Limit buys (lowball the bid) as price taps the negative GEX pit. Enter on red candles into the node. Never chase — never use market orders. Minimum 3:1 R/R filter: measure risk to upside node vs distance to downside. Example: 10 pts risk up vs 55 pts potential down = 5.5:1.
exit: Scale out partials at the first Gatekeeper node above. Hold runners if the 61.8-79% Fibonacci Golden Zone holds. If 'Clear Skies' (no upside resistance nodes), let it run.
probability: High when VIX is elevated (Vanna acceleration) and Trinity shows floor confluence.
key_rules: Trampoline Effect: ITM puts being closed → dealer hedge buyback → price reversal
3:1 Minimum R/R: never enter without asymmetric payoff
VIX Confluence: VIX 'hollow candles' (overheating) + -GEX floor = max bounce probability
Node Rate of Change: if pit node grows 20%+ in velocity, it's becoming THE magnet
edge_cases: VEX Override: during VIX spikes, VEX takes control — distant VEX nodes become magnetic, potentially pulling price THROUGH the GEX pit
3rd Touch: if floor was already tested 2x, probability of break-through increases
